display_long_description:
**WARNING:** This game must be played by at least 2 people. One player is immersed in VR, while their partner must have the Support File in hand: https://cortexquest.github.io/VR.
# Train your brain. Become the system.

Step into a VR experience where science meets gameplay. CORTEX QUEST is a collection of immersive mini-games for anyone ready to explore the mysteries of the human brain and sensory systems.

# PSYCHOLOGY SIMULATIONS - Perception is not reality

Experience neurological disorders and how perception can dramatically change.

Explore three fascinating conditions:

- Prosopagnosia - struggle to recognize faces and rely on alternative cues
- Hemineglect - navigate a world where half of reality seems to disappear
- Body Ownership Impairment - question what truly belongs to your own body

Each simulation challenges your senses and shows how the brain constructs reality.

# BIOLOGY ADVENTURE - HEAR WE GO!

A scientific accident has changed everything… Your team of biologists has been miniaturized and sent inside the human body. Your mission: explore the auditory system and uncover how we perceive sound.

Equipped with advanced VR tools, you will:

- Dive into the cochlea and uncover its mechanics
- Activate hair cells and observe how sound becomes signals
- Manipulate sound frequencies to understand pitch perception
- Trigger action potentials and follow neural pathways
- Travel to the auditory cortex

Learn hearing by doing, experimenting, and interacting.
